newsitem.title: USA: Shaw sees Q3/Q4 hurt by fewer bookings.
newsitem.headline: Shaw sees Q3/Q4 hurt by fewer bookings.

text.p: Shaw Group Inc said Monday its sales and earnings for the third and fourth quarters of its fiscal year 1997 will be reduced because project bookings during the second quarter for the international power and domestic chemical and refinery sectors were less than previously expected.
However, it said that in light of the award of a major refinery project in India and its strategy to increase bookings, it anticipates at this time "a strong fiscal 1998."
From an earnings standpoint, it said that the refinery project in India "is roughly analogous to a $100 million refinery project."
Shaw Group is a piping systems fabricator that provides its products to the electric power, chemical and refining industries worldwide.

Earlier today, the company reported net income on primary shares of $0.31 for its second fiscal quarter, up from $0.20 per share it posted in the comparable year-ago quarter, on net income of $3.6 million, up from $1.8 million a year ago.
